headline: First published multi-model comparison
method: 2 trials × 12 code review tasks (4 public; 8 owner-private holdouts). Candidate arms used the same input code, model, output contract and scoring for the corresponding model pair.
conclusions: With Sonnet 5.5, both methods detected 48/48 key issues; Gate Keeper reduced false positives from 15 to 7 at higher token cost.
The cheaper Haiku 5.5 missed 5–8 key issues; it is not qualified as a standalone review model.
The 6/6 repair fixtures were saturated across all evaluated repair configurations and do not establish a meaningful repair-method advantage.
limitations: Run result is INCONCLUSIVE, not independently qualified.
Original run routed through a direct Anthropic provider, not a proven Stranger Builds sponsor-funded gateway.
Dollar figures are estimated from token counts and list prices, not provider invoices or verified sponsor credit deductions.
The 8 holdout cases and raw session traces remain private; no evidence from them is exposed in this display.
A separate Fable 5.1 LLM graded the original run; that is not an independent human verifier.
